meta.name: taobao-keyword-search
meta.description: Search Taobao and Tmall product listings by keyword, returning paginated product cards with title, price, shop, image, sales, and tags. Use when user asks to search Taobao, find products on Taobao/Tmall, scrape Taobao search results, get product listings from Taobao, collect Taobao items by keyword, 搜索淘宝, 淘宝关键词搜索, 采集淘宝商品, 抓取淘宝搜索结果, 淘宝天猫商品列表. Also applies to bulk keyword searches, price monitoring across keywords, and competitive product research on Taobao.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按关键词搜索淘宝天猫商品，获取价格、销量等详情
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在淘宝天猫上按关键词批量搜索商品并获取详细信息
copy.tagline_en: Search Taobao and Tmall products by keyword, get price, sales and details
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to search Taobao/Tmall by keyword and collect product details

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以按关键词搜索淘宝和天猫商品，返回分页的商品列表，包含标题、价格、店铺、图片、销量和标签等信息。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索淘宝、查找淘宝/天猫商品、采集淘宝商品列表，或进行批量关键词搜索、价格监控、竞品调研时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索淘宝上“蓝牙耳机”的商品。
搜索天猫上“运动鞋”，按销量排序，价格100到500元。
say.note: 返回天猫商品，按销量排序，价格过滤。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search Taobao and Tmall product listings by keyword, returning paginated product cards with title, price, shop, image, sales, and tags.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to search Taobao, find products on Taobao/Tmall, scrape Taobao search results, or perform bulk keyword searches, price monitoring, or competitive product research.

say_en.text: Search Tmall for "sneakers", sort by sales, price 100 to 500 yuan.
say_en.note: Returns Tmall items sorted by sales with price filter.
